summary: Distributed POSIX file system built on Redis and S3, providing high-performance storage for cloud-native and big data applications.
usecases: Shared file storage for distributed microservices accessing common data across nodes
Big data analytics pipelines requiring low-latency access to object-stored data
Hybrid cloud storage bridging on-premises Redis caches with S3 object storage
ideas: Use as a distributed cache layer for AI model training datasets stored in S3
Implement as a global file system for edge computing nodes syncing with central cloud storage
Integrate with Terraform for automated deployment of scalable file storage infrastructure
